GARDENA CITY COUNCIL

  Council Chamber at City Hall
  1700 West 162 nd Street, Gardena, California
  Website: www.cityofgardena.org

  Tuesday, March 11, 2025
  Open Session 7:30 p.m.
TASHA CERDA, Mayor  MINA SEMENZA, City Clerk
RODNEY G. TANAKA, Mayor Pro Tem  GUY H. MATO, City Treasurer
MARK E. HENDERSON, Council Member  CLINT OSORIO, City Manager
PAULETTE C. FRANCIS, Council Member  CARMEN VASQUEZ, City Attorney
WANDA LOVE, Council Member  LISA KRANITZ, Assistant City Attorney

If you would like to participate in this meeting, you can participate via the following
options:
  1. VIEW THE MEETING live on SPECTRUM CHANNEL 22 or ONLINE at
  youtube.com/CityofGardena

  2. PARTICIPATE BEFORE THE MEETING by emailing the Deputy City Clerk at
  publiccomment@cityofgardena.org by 5:00p.m. on the day of the meeting and write
  "Public Comment" in the subject line.

  3. ATTEND THE MEETING IN PERSON

  PUBLIC COMMENT: The City Council will hear from the public on any item on the
  agenda or any item of interest that is not on the agenda at the following times:
  Agenda Items – At the time the City Council considers the item or during Oral
  Communications
  Non-agenda Items – During Oral Communications
  Public Hearings – At the time for Public Hearings listed on the Agenda
  If you wish to address the Council, please complete a “Speaker Request” form and
  present it to the City Clerk or Sergeant of Arms. You will be called to the podium by
  name when it is your turn to address the Council. The City Council cannot legally take
  action on any item not scheduled on the Agenda. Such items may be referred for
  administrative action or scheduled on a future Agenda. Members of the public wishing to
  address the City Council will be given three (3) minutes to speak.

  4. The City of Gardena, in complying with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA),
  requests individuals who require special accommodations to access, attend and/or
  participate in the City meeting due to disability, to please contact the City Clerk's Office
  by phone (310) 217-9565 or email cityclerk@cityofgardena.org at least 24 business
  hours prior to the scheduled general meeting to ensure assistance is provided. Assistive
  listening devices are available.

  1
 STANDARDS OF BEHAVIOR THAT PROMOTE CIVILITY AT ALL PUBLIC MEETINGS

  Treat everyone courteously;
  Listen to others respectfully;
  Exercise self-control;
  Give open-minded consideration to all viewpoints;
  Focus on the issues and avoid personalizing debate; and
  Embrace respectful disagreement and dissent as democratic rights, inherent
  components of an inclusive public process, and tools for forging sound decisions

Thank you for your attendance and cooperation

  In December of 2021 an application was filed to establish the 1450 Artesia Specific
  Plan to develop the 6.33-acre property near the southwest corner of Artesia Blvd
  and Normandie Avenue with a new 268,000 square foot commercial/industrial
  mixed-use building for self-storage, office and industrial uses, and to allow the site
  for outdoor community event space.

  On February 25, 2025, the City Council held a publicly noticed hearing to discuss
  the adoption of Ordinance No. 1879, which approves the 1450 Artesia Specific

  the council approved it with a unanimous 5-0 vote, with an amendment to the

  20. COUNCIL DIRECTIVES

  Council Member Love

  Subject: For staff to draft a handbook and establish a structured on-boarding process for
  newly elected officials within the first 60 days of being sworn into office.

  Purpose - To provide newly elected officials with a comprehensive introduction to key
  department directors, administrative staff and city operations, ensuring they are well
  equipped to fulfill their responsibilities of effectively.

  6
 Docusign Envelope ID: E9406B2D-CBDF-4385-9CD0-A39FF8A316DE

  Reason - A structured on-boarding process and handbook will help newly elected officials
  become familiar with their roles, responsibilities, and the city operations, allowing them to
  serve the community more efficiently and make informed decisions.

  Benefit - Implementing this directive would benefit the city of Gardena by enhancing
  government efficiency that will help the newly elected to be better informed to make quicker
  and more effective decisions and reducing delays in governance. Improve collaborations
  by fostering early relationships with department heads and city staff, the elected official can
  streamline communication and cooperation across the departments. Ensuring consistency
  by creating a standardized onboarding process and handbook to ensure all officials receive
  the same foundation of knowledge, maintaining continuity and leadership.

  Council Member Henderson seconded it.

  22. COUNCIL REMARKS

  1) COUNCIL MEMBER LOVE - Since the last meeting, she has attended the KJLH Proven
  Achievers Award representing the City of Gardena. She had the great pleasure of
  hanging out with Stevie Wonder, retired Senator Steven Bradford, and so many others.
  She congratulated all the honorees that won those awards. The honorees did amazing
  things in the community, like Cheyenne Bryant, who has millions of followers, and is an
  amazing Counselor, Warryn Campbell, husband of one of the singers Mary, Mary, a
  gentleman who owns a self-build library; teaching inner-city kids how to write books and
  publish books, and the first African American female referee in the NBA. She mentioned
  she has a message for the community and for the residents who see her out in public
  and are asking how she is doing. She mentioned she is doing fine, despite all of the
  drama that's been going on, and as Councilwoman Francis would normally say, “better
  days are coming”.

  2) COUNCIL MEMBER FRANCIS – She started by giving a shout out to our staff and
  thanked them for all the presentations that were given tonight, she appreciates it because
  it keeps her better informed and updated about what’s going on in our City. She
  mentioned since the last meeting, she attended the South Bay Workforce Investment
  Board orientation and Youth Basketball Award Banquet, and she wished a Happy
  Women’s History Month, and Happy Saint Patrick's Day. She mentioned regarding
  Women's History Month; it has been said that “the hand that rocks the cradle rules the
  world”. She knows a lot is going on in this world, you see a lot of crazy things going on
  in the news, and you hear a lot of stuff but, stay faithful, and keep the faith, better days
  are coming, it’s been promised.

  takes time for them to line up everything, line up the funding, line up and coordinate with

  Southbaycities.org. Also, on Wednesday the 19th, it is the 88 City Summit, at the
